species_system: RL95-2 HUMAN ENDOMETRIAL CARCINOMA LINE for every cell experiment - the SAME line as Yu 2018 (DRREF-005), so the two references are NOT independent system support. Trophoblast side is HTR-8/SVneo, an SV40-immortalised first-trimester line. NO primary human endometrial epithelium and NO organoid anywhere. Human tissue arm is BULK RNA-seq re-analysis of GSE98386 (20 fertile women, paired early- vs mid-secretory), expression only.
perturbation_used: Recombinant human IL-1beta 20 ng/mL (SINGLE CONCENTRATION, no dose-response), 48 h to prepare monolayers and 4 d continuous for transcript measurement; FUT3 siRNA 10 nM (Silencer Select s5412) versus non-target control; anti-sLeX antibody 5 ug/mL for 1 h versus IgM isotype control
proximal_measurement: Surface sLeX and LeY by flow cytometry (MFI and percent positive, n=6) and by immunocytochemistry - i.e. THE GLYCAN EPITOPE ITSELF, not a transcript proxy; ST3GAL3/4/6 and FUT1/2/3/4/7 mRNA by TaqMan RT-qPCR (n=6); FUT3 protein by immunoblot with GAPDH densitometry
functional_measurement: HTR-8/SVneo spheroid (100-200 um) attachment to confluent RL95-2 monolayers after 2 h coculture, expressed as percent of transferred spheroids (n=18 for blockade, n=9 for knockdown)
what_is_supported: FULL TEXT READ 2026-09-18. (1) AN UPSTREAM DETERMINANT FOR SURFACE sLeX NOW EXISTS, AND IT IS A DETERMINANT OF THE VARIABLE THE NODE NAMES: IL-1beta raises surface sLeX measured AS surface sLeX by flow cytometry (p<0.0001), so section 5(2)'s activity-versus-abundance test does NOT fire here - unlike S_FOXO1, E_SOX17 and E_ITGA2B1. LeY is unchanged in the same cells, an internal specificity control. (2) IL-1beta raises spheroid attachment (p<0.01). (3) Anti-sLeX blockade reduces attachment at BOTH basal and IL-1beta-induced conditions (p<0.05 and p<0.001); at 1 h pretreatment plus 2 h coculture this arm LARGELY AVOIDS the proliferation confound that a 72 h knockdown or a 4 d cytokine exposure carries, and is the cleanest evidence in the paper. STATED AT THAT WIDTH AND NO WIDER: acute viability and cytotoxicity were NOT directly measured in any arm, so a proliferation explanation is very unlikely here rather than excluded, and this arm does not rule out every viability effect. (4) FUT3 siRNA lowers FUT3 mRNA and protein, lowers surface sLeX (p<0.05 basal, p<0.01 induced), leaves LeY unmodified, and lowers attachment at both conditions (p<0.05 and p<0.0001) - so FUT3 is a necessary biosynthetic input to the sLeX epitope in this system. (5) Human tissue: FUT3 and IL1B are both higher in mid- than early-secretory endometrium (p<0.001, Wilcoxon signed-rank, n=20 paired) and correlate (Spearman r=0.72, p<0.0001). (6) DECISIVE AGAINST THE CO-REGULATED TRANSCRIPTIONAL PROGRAMME: under ONE stimulus in the SAME cells, FUT3 RISES (p<0.001) while ST3GAL3 FALLS (p<0.05), ST3GAL4 falls (p<0.01), FUT4 and FUT7 fall (p<0.05); ST3GAL6 and FUT1 do not reach significance; FUT2 is undetectable. The authors state the dissociation in terms: sLeX is 'not suppressed by IL-1beta induced decrease of ST3GAL3/4 and FUT7 but rather enhanced by the upregulated FUT3'.

species_system: PRIMARY HUMAN ENDOMETRIAL EPITHELIAL CELLS (HEECs, n=5), freshly isolated by collagenase digestion from functionalis curettage of women with regular cycles and no hormone use for 3 months - the best human system of any candidate read across U4b and this increment. The primary-cell evidence is confined to Figure 1A (knockdown), Figure 1C (adhesion) and Figure 3B (NOTCH3 NICD).
perturbation_used: JAG1 siRNA 20 nM versus scrambled control in HEECs and Ishikawa; MAML1 siRNA 20 nM versus scrambled control in ISHIKAWA ONLY; 2'OMe-modified cholesterol-conjugated AgoJag1 siRNA 10 ug by intrauterine injection at E3 in mouse, paired horns within animal. NO HORMONAL, STEROIDAL, cAMP OR CYTOKINE PERTURBATION OF JAG1 ANYWHERE.
proximal_measurement: NOTCH1-4 NICD by cleaved-intracellular-domain-specific immunoblot with GAPDH densitometry (n=3-4) - i.e. PATHWAY ACTIVITY, not transcript abundance, which is what the node's definition as a signalling state requires; HEY1 and HES1 qPCR (n=7); seven receptivity markers, PGR and ESR1 by qPCR; JAG1 by qPCR, immunoblot and immunocytochemistry; mouse 83-gene RT2 Profiler array on E4 luminal epithelium
functional_measurement: HTR8/SVneo spheroid adhesion to HEEC (2 h) and Ishikawa (4 h) monolayers, percent of transferred spheroids (n=5); xCELLigence real-time cell index over 8 h as adhesion and to 72 h as proliferation; mouse implantation sites at E4.5 by Chicago blue dye (n=5)
what_is_supported: FULL TEXT READ 2026-09-18. (1) JAG1 IS REQUIRED FOR FULL EPITHELIAL ADHESIVE CAPACITY IN PRIMARY HUMAN CELLS: JAG1 knockdown significantly reduced HEEC and Ishikawa adhesion to trophoblast spheroids (both p<0.05, Fig 1C). (2) THE VIABILITY CONFOUND IS BOUNDED HERE, WHICH IT IS NOT IN YU 2018 OR MA 2023: xCELLigence shows adhesion significantly reduced within 3-8 h of seeding (p<0.05) while the authors state proliferation was UNIMPAIRED UP TO 60 h and fell only after 80 h (p<0.0001, Supplemental Figure 2), so the adhesion effect is temporally separated from the proliferation effect rather than entangled with it. (3) THE NODE IS MEASURED AS ACTIVITY: NOTCH3 NICD was significantly decreased by JAG1 knockdown in Ishikawa (p<0.05, Fig 3A), by receptor-specific cleaved-domain immunoblot. (4) Canonical Notch output falls: HEY1 down (p<0.01) while HES1 is unaffected (Ishikawa, Fig 2A). (5) Five of seven receptivity markers fall on JAG1 knockdown in Ishikawa - LIFR, SPP1, ITGB3, MAOA, IGFBP1 - while GPX3 and DPP4 do not (Fig 2B-C). (6) CANONICAL-NOTCH DEPENDENCE ISOLATES SPP1 AND ONLY SPP1: MAML1 knockdown reduced SPP1 (p<0.05) and did NOT affect LIFR, ITGB3, MAOA or IGFBP1 (Fig 2E-F); the authors note SPP1 carries an RBPJ site at -723 to -734 bp. (7) Mouse: Jag1 knockdown in uterine luminal epithelium significantly reduced implantation sites (p<0.05).
what_is_NOT_supported: ANY DETERMINANT. NO HORMONAL OR CONTEXTUAL INPUT TO JAG1 IS PERTURBED ANYWHERE IN THE PAPER - no E2, no progestin, no cAMP, no cytokine. The only upstream statement is observational cycle-phase immunostaining carried over from the authors' prior work. U4b's blocking field (d), the one it called the one that matters most, therefore answers NEGATIVELY and DRUNR-005 STANDS IN FULL: NO IN_P4 -> JAG1, NO IN_E2 -> JAG1 AND NO E_SECRETORY_STATE -> JAG1 IS LICENSED. ALSO NOT SUPPORTED: NOTCH3 AS THE NECESSARY RECEPTOR. No NOTCH3 knockdown, blockade or gamma-secretase arm exists; receptor attribution rests entirely on the DIRECTION of NICD change, and NOTCH1 AND NOTCH2 NICD were significantly INCREASED by JAG1 knockdown, which the authors concede did not compensate. Their own wording is that JAG1-NOTCH3 'may play a dominant role'. ALSO NOT SUPPORTED: A SIGNIFICANT PRIMARY-CELL NOTCH3 RESULT. Figure 3B's legend gives P = 0.073 at n = 3 for the HEEC NOTCH3 NICD reduction, while the Results text and the Abstract both describe it as 'confirmed'. THE LEGEND GOVERNS: the primary-cell leg of the receptor half is a NON-SIGNIFICANT TREND, and the discrepancy is recorded here so a later unit does not inherit the abstract's wording. ALSO NOT SUPPORTED: TREATING EVERY JAG1-DEPENDENT GENE AS DOWNSTREAM OF THIS NODE. Four of the five regulated markers - LIFR, ITGB3, MAOA, IGFBP1 - SURVIVE MAML1 knockdown, so they are Notch-INDEPENDENT outputs of JAG1 and MUST NOT become downstream edges of E_JAG1_NOTCH3, however model-relevant ITGB3 and IGFBP1 are. ALSO NOT SUPPORTED: ANY JAG1 -> PGR OR JAG1 -> ESR1 EDGE. Both are explicitly UNCHANGED in the human models (Fig 2D). Mouse Esr1 DOES fall, and that is a species difference that must not be imported. ALSO NOT SUPPORTED: TIGHT-JUNCTION EDGES IN HUMAN. Cldn4, Cldn1 and Ocln fall in mouse luminal epithelium; CLDN4 is explicitly NOT regulated in HEECs or Ishikawa (Supplemental Figure 3). The canonical targets also diverge by species - HEY1 falls in human and not HES1, Hes1 falls in mouse and not Hey1 - and the authors conclude the two species act 'likely via different mechanisms'. NO MOUSE-ONLY FINDING MAY BECOME A HUMAN EPITHELIAL EDGE. AND NOT SUPPORTED: A BLASTOCYST ENDPOINT IN THE HUMAN ARM - the spheroid is an immortalised trophoblast line - or a complete-loss claim, since knockdown was partial and the authors say so.

canonical_promotion_decision: NO PROMOTION, AND NO EXECUTABLE RULE. THE NODE MOVES AND THE ENCODING DOES NOT. Node admission: section 5(1) is now SATISFIED and satisfied well - a causal perturbation in PRIMARY human endometrial epithelium with a functional endpoint, a pathway-ACTIVITY readout for a node defined as a signalling state, and a temporally bounded viability control. node_verdict UNVERIFIED -> JUSTIFIED_SYSTEM_LIMITED, where the limitation is NOT the cell system for the adhesion claim but the fact that two of the node's three named measurables (NOTCH3, HEY1) are Ishikawa-only and the primary-cell NOTCH3 replication is p=0.073. THE FIRST FAILING CRITERION MOVES FROM 5(1) TO 5(2): no determinant is perturbed anywhere, so the paper answers the node question and leaves the encoding question exactly where DRUNR-005 left it. Disposition WAIT_FOR_EXPERIMENT under the owner-ratified 5(2) wording, applied to the evidence missing AT THE FIRST FAILING RUNG, following the S_FOXO1 precedent of adding a protein readout across existing arms rather than the E_SOX17 precedent of an externally-blocked replication. WHAT THE NODE MAY DEFENSIBLY MEAN, NARROWED TO THE EVIDENCE: the epithelial state in which JAG1 is present and JAG1-dependent NOTCH3 NICD is being produced, functionally coupled to trophoblast-spheroid adhesive capacity. It may NOT mean that NOTCH3 is the necessary receptor for that adhesion, and it may NOT be used to explain the four Notch-INDEPENDENT markers.
